Despite resistance from the die-hards and an R rating, Cregger’s Resident Evil grossed $60 million over the weekend.
In just its opening days, Deadline reports, Resident Evil has grossed between $53 and 60 million.
18, the film grossed $26.3 million domestically, which is almost as much as Resident Evil: The Final Chapter earned domestically during its entire run.
It’s also Cregger’s best opening to date, beating out his previous hit Weapons, which grossed $43.5 million during its first three days.
